The Demon Deacons were led by third-year head coach [[Danny Manning]]. The team played their home games at the [[Lawrence Joel Veterans Memorial Coliseum]] in [[Winston-Salem, North Carolina]] as a member of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 19–14, 9–9 in [[2016–17 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in tenth place. They defeated [[2016–17 Boston College Eagles men's basketball team|Boston College]] in the first round of the [[2017 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to advance to the second round where they lost to [[2016–17 Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball team|Virginia Tech]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 11 seed in the South region. There they lost in the First Four to [[2016–17 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]]. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|Demon Deacons]] finished [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 11–20, 2–16 in [[2015–16 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in 14th place.
